content: This work was carried out when Aizhan Imankulova was taking up an internship at NICT, Japan. We would like to thank the reviewers for their insightful comments. A part of this work was conducted under the program “Promotion of Global Communications Plan: Research, Development, and Social Demonstration of Multilingual Speech Translation Technology” of the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications (MIC), Japan.
